All three files are valid. Here's what was built:

---

**`index.html`** — standalone document linking `styles.css` + `app.js`

### Sections
| Section | Details |
|---|---|
| **Announcement bar** | Promo strip with free-shipping offer |
| **Sticky navbar** | Logo, nav links, search/account/cart icons with live cart badge, mobile hamburger |
| **Hero** | Full-bleed dark gradient with headline, CTA buttons, store stats, and decorative product cards |
| **Category filter** | Pill buttons (All / Tech / Fashion / Home / Beauty / Sport) that show/hide matching product cards |
| **Featured Products** | 8-card grid with emoji thumbnails, badges (Sale/New/Hot), star ratings, wishlist toggle, add-to-cart |
| **Today's Deals** | Flash deal with live countdown timer + two side deals |
| **Brand marquee** | Animated scrolling brand strip (pauses on hover) |
| **The Edit** | Editorial grid — 1 lead story + 2 supporting articles with author info |
| **Newsletter** | Email capture form with toast confirmation |
| **Footer** | 4-column links, social buttons, legal bar |

### Interactions
- **Add to cart** → button turns green ✓, cart count badge increments, toast notification
- **Wishlist** → toggle heart ♡/♥ with toast
- **Countdown timer** — live seconds ticker on flash deal
- **Category filter** — instant client-side filtering
- **Newsletter** — submits with success toast
